section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement procedures and translation methodology for questionnaires used in the study. Questionnaires not available in Danish, Portuguese, and Swedish were translated using back-translation technique. The factor structure of translated measures (IES-2 and RSES in Danish and Swedish) was assessed. Pilot testing was conducted with 4 participants (2 boys and 2 girls, ages 12-19) per country to assess face validity and understanding of BAS-2 items, which were confirmed to be clear and understandable.
